children: shares were up 5.87% intraday as of 1:20 p.m. ET after Evercore ISI's quarterly channel partner survey pointed to a firming cybersecurity budget outlook heading into year-end. The survey named CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks
as the leading beneficiaries of AI-driven security spending. Palo Alto shares were up 6.11%.

Partners ranked identity protection, AI governance and cloud security as top enterprise priorities, all areas covered by CrowdStrike's Falcon platform. Evercore also flagged two critical PHP vulnerabilities disclosed on October 21, known as PHP2Shell, as a catalyst for higher security spending. The flaws affect a programming language used by roughly 70% of websites and could let attackers run code remotely on vulnerable servers.

The survey adds to recent analyst support. Mizuho raised its CrowdStrike price target to $275 from $250 on Thursday and kept an Outperform rating, citing early channel checks on Falcon Guardian, the company's AI agent security product.

title: CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Rally as Evercore Sees Firmer Budgets
